name: terrace_victorian
cues: joined row houses 3-5 storeys; brick or white stucco; sash windows taller than wide in vertical bays; ground-floor porticos/doors per unit; pitched or valley roofs, chimney rows; iron railings at street

name: cbd_tower
cues: office tower or slab over ~8 storeys; curtain-wall glass or dense punched grid; flat roof with plant/parapet; podium at street; sometimes rounded corners, setbacks, pyramid or crown top

name: rail_terminus
cues: long low shed with glazed pitched roof on iron/steel trusses; open platform sides; arcaded masonry flank walls; wedge-shaped plan ends possible

name: canal_house
cues: narrow deep row house 3-5 storeys on a canal or dense old street; gable facing street (stepped/bell/neck gable); large windows stacked; hoist beam at top

name: machiya
cues: low wooden townhouse 1-3 storeys; dark timber lattice fronts; tiled pitched roof with deep eaves; narrow frontage, deep plan

name: brutalist_estate
cues: exposed board-marked concrete; repeated deep balcony bands or access decks; massive piers/pilotis; towers on podium or long slabs; small windows in heavy frames

name: gothic_church
cues: church or chapel; pointed-arch windows, buttresses, tower or spire; steep pitched roof; stone tracery

name: industrial_shed
cues: single-storey wide-span shed; profiled metal or brick skin; sawtooth or shallow-pitch roof; roller doors; few windows

name: shophouse
cues: 2-4 storey row with continuous shopfronts at ground; living floors above with shuttered windows; covered walkway/arcade possible

name: panel_housing
cues: prefabricated concrete-panel apartment slab or tower; strictly repeated window grid; visible panel joints; minimal ornament

name: courtyard_vernacular
cues: low buildings around an inner courtyard; thick rendered or mudbrick walls; small windows; flat or low tiled roof

name: haussmann_block
cues: 5-7 storey stone apartment block; continuous balconies on 2nd/5th floors; mansard roof with dormers; tall shuttered windows

name: warehouse_conversion
cues: 4-8 storey brick warehouse; large segmental-arch window openings in regular grid; loading doors/hoists; flat or shallow roof

name: suburban_detached
cues: free-standing 1-2 storey house with garden; pitched roof; porch/garage; irregular plan

name: civic_classical
cues: monumental stone public building; giant-order columns or pilasters; pediment; balustraded parapet; symmetric grand entrance
